game.name: Midway Arcade Origins (USA)
game.desc: Midway Arcade Origins on Xbox 360 is a compilation of 31 old titles. It includes games such as Gauntlet, Rampage, Joust, Spy Hunter, Defender, Marble Madness. Players can also play with up to three friends in local and co-op multiplayer modes, as well as publish their high scores online.
